book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book informs concepts and teaching structure; notes, numerical examples and short checks are independently written. No textbook exercises or artwork are copied.

conventions: Exact probabilities and moments are requested unless stated otherwise.
Repeated numerical labels refer to distinct physical items or sectors.
Independence is stated for independent experiments; without-replacement selections are not independent.
Variance is E(X²) − [E(X)]²; sample-variance n−1 corrections are not used.
Finite recoding and total-score models are solved through distributions, not assumed S2 formulas.
All final branches of capped procedures include their stated success and failure cases.
sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only; written reasoning, finite distribution interpretation and method marks use the existing manual/teacher workflow.
